question: En cáncer de pulmón, ¿qué fármacos dirigidos a PDCD1 o CD274 (PD-1 o PD-L1) aparecen en ensayos de fase 3 o fase 2/3?

attempts.query:
SELECT DISTINCT d.pref_name
FROM linking.trial_drug td
JOIN aact.studies s ON s.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id AND tg.gene_symbol IN ('PDCD1','CD274')
JOIN linking.drug d ON d.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_condition tc
  JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
  JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id AND md.label = 'Lung Neoplasms'
  WHERE tc.nct_id = td.nct_id)
ORDER BY 1
